Rashi on Megillah 27a:11:1.english: And [one] places a sheet upon another - One sheet is rolled onto another:

Rashi on Megillah 27a:13:1.hebrew: משום פשיעותא - שמא משימכור, שוב לא יקנה, ומתוך כך יפסדו הדמים:
Rashi on Megillah 27a:13:1.english: Because of negligence - lest once he sells [the old scroll], he will not buy [a new one], and as a result the money will be lost.

Rashi on Megillah 27a:13:2.hebrew: כי קאמרינן דמנח לאיפרוקי - שכתוב כבר החדש בבית הסופר, ואינו מעוכב אלא לתת לו דמים:
Rashi on Megillah 27a:13:2.english: When we speak [of a case where it is] waiting to be redeemed - [meaning] that the new [one] is already written in the scribe's house, and it is only held up [waiting] to give him payment:

Rashi on Megillah 27a:14:1.hebrew: אלא ללמוד תורה - להתפרנס בו כשלומד תורה, וקס"ד דה"ה לקנות ספר תורה:
Rashi on Megillah 27a:14:1.english: Only to study Torah - [i.e.,] to support oneself from [the proceeds] while studying Torah; and [the Gemara] initially assumed that the same applies to buying a Torah scroll:

Rashi on Megillah 27a:16:1.english: That he does not need it - [Meaning] that he has another [Torah scroll]:

Rashi on Megillah 27a:16:2.english: He never sees a sign of blessing - from that money:

Rashi on Megillah 27a:17:1.hebrew: שמכרו והותירו - מכרו אחד מן הקדושות הללו, ולקחו ממקצת הדמים קדושה מעולה, והותירו מהן:
Rashi on Megillah 27a:17:1.english: [Where] they sold and had [funds] left over - [That is,] they sold one of these sacred [items], and purchased with part of the proceeds [an item of] higher sanctity, and had [some] of them left over:

Rashi on Megillah 27a:17:2.hebrew: אבל גבו - מעות מן הצבור לצורך ספר תורה וקנאוהו, ונותר בידן מן הדמים — מותר להורידן, שהרי עדיין לא באו לשימוש קדושה חמורה:
Rashi on Megillah 27a:17:2.english: However, [if] they collected - money from the community for the purpose of [buying] a Torah scroll and they bought it, and [some] of the money remained in their possession — it is permitted to lower them [in sanctity], for they have not yet come to the use of a stricter sanctity:

Rashi on Megillah 27a:18:1.english: When they did not stipulate - on condition to do as we wish with the money:

Rashi on Megillah 27a:18:2.english: For a dukhsusya - [The Gemara] explains [it] below:

Rashi on Megillah 27a:19:1.english: When they made a stipulation, of what [avail] is it - After all, they are the proceeds of sanctity:

Rashi on Megillah 27a:19:2.hebrew: וטעמא דהתנו - כשגבו, "לעשות רצוננו וחפצנו ממותר הדמים":
Rashi on Megillah 27a:19:2.english: And the reason is that they stipulated - when they collected [the funds, they stipulated], "to do our will and our desire with the leftover funds":

Rashi on Megillah 27a:21:1.english: The town horseman - The townspeople hire a man who rides a horse, [so] that he will be available to them to send him on an errand to the ruler of the city when they need [to]:

Rashi on Megillah 27a:23:1.hebrew: נותנין - אותה לגבאי אותה העיר, כדי שלא יחשדום בפוסקים ואינן נותנין:
Rashi on Megillah 27a:23:1.english: They give - it to the charity collectors of that town, so that they will not suspect them of [being among] those who pledge and do not give:

Rashi on Megillah 27a:23:2.hebrew: וכשהן באים - וחוזרים למקומן, תובעים אותן מן הגבאים ומפרנסין בה עניי עירן:
Rashi on Megillah 27a:23:2.english: And when they come [back] - and return to their [own] place, they claim it from the charity collectors and support the poor of their town with it:

Rashi on Megillah 27a:2:1.english: And he burnt the house of the Lord ... and every great house - [This] is written regarding Nebuzaradan:

Rashi on Megillah 27a:4:1.english: Conclude - There is a sign [i.e., proof]:

Rashi on Megillah 27a:4:2.english: [It is] permitted to make [it into] a study hall - Thus, a study hall is a "great house":

Rashi on Megillah 27a:6:1.hebrew: דיעבד - שמכרוהו כבר, כדקתני "מכרו תורה", ומשום הכי מותר ליקח בדמיו ספר תורה, שאם לאו — מה יקחו מהם? "כי קא מיבעיא לן" — למכור לכתחילה לכך:
Rashi on Megillah 27a:6:1.english: After the fact - [meaning] that they already sold it, as [the Mishnah] teaches, "if they sold a Torah [scroll]," and therefore it is permitted to purchase a Torah scroll with its proceeds, for if not, what would they purchase with them? "When the dilemma was raised to us" — [it was regarding whether one may] sell [a Torah scroll] in the first place for this [purpose]:

Rashi on Megillah 27a:7:1.english: Chumashin - a Torah scroll that contains only one fifth [i.e., one book of the Torah]:

Rashi on Megillah 27a:7:2.english: However, [a scroll of] the Prophets or Writings [may] not [be rolled up] in wrapping cloths [of] a Torah scroll - for he lowers the wrapping cloths from their sanctity:

Rashi on Megillah 27a:8:1.english: In wrapping cloths of Chumashim [scrolls of individual books of the Torah] - because he is elevating the wrapping cloths [in sanctity]:

Rashi on Megillah 27a:8:2.hebrew: אבל במטפחות ספר תורה לא - אלמא אין משנין לכיוצא בה, אלא למעלה הימנה:
Rashi on Megillah 27a:8:2.english: But in wrapping cloths of a Torah scroll, no - Thus [we see that] one may not change [its use] to [something] similar to it, only to [something] higher than it:

Rashi on Megillah 27a:9:1.english: Say the latter clause: "And [scrolls of] the five books [of the Torah may not be wrapped] in wrapping cloths of a Torah scroll" - for that is a lowering [in sanctity]:

Tosafot on Megillah 27a:1:1.hebrew: כוותיה דרב פפי מסתברא - מהכא משמע דהלכה כר' יהושע בן לוי לגבי דר' יוחנן, מדמייתי ראיה דהלכה כרב פפי משום דרבי יהושע בן לוי קאי כוותיה, אע"ג דרבי יוחנן פליג עליה:
Tosafot on Megillah 27a:1:1.english: In accordance with Rav Pappi, it stands to reason - From here it is implied that the halakha is in accordance with Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi as against Rabbi Yoḥanan, since [the Gemara] brings proof that the halakha is in accordance with Rav Pappi because Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi holds like him, even though Rabbi Yoḥanan disagrees with him:

Tosafot on Megillah 27a:20:1.hebrew: אבל התנו ז' טובי העיר במעמד כו' - קשה, דכיון שהתנו ז' טובי העיר במעמד אנשי העיר, למה לי להותירו, ואמאי נקטיה? והא אפי' בכל הדמים יכולין הן לעשות מה שירצו, כדאמר לעיל: "אפילו למישתי ביה שיכרא", ופרש"י: לקנות מן הדמים שכר לשתות! ויש לומר דנקט "והותירו" לאשמועינן דאף במותר בעי תנאי; דסלקא דעתך דאם קנו מן הדמים דבר קדושה והותירו, דמותר לעשות מן המותר כל מה שירצו אפילו בלא תנאי, קמ"ל דלא:
Tosafot on Megillah 27a:20:1.english: However, if the seven representatives of the town made a stipulation in an assembly, etc. - This is difficult: since the seven representatives of the town made a stipulation in an assembly of the residents of the town, why do I need [the case where] "there was [money] left over," and why did [the Gemara] mention it? After all, even with all the money they can do whatever they wish, as [the Gemara] said above: "even to drink beer with it," and Rashi explained: to buy beer with the money to drink! And one can say that [the Gemara] mentioned "and there was [money] left over" to teach us that even with the leftover [money] a stipulation is required; for it might have entered your mind that if they bought a sacred object with the money and there was [money] left over, it is permitted to do whatever they wish with the leftover [money] even without a stipulation — [therefore] it teaches us that [this is] not [so]:
